forecastNote: Working outlook based on the official October 30 division standings and confirmed crossover results. Exact league tiebreaks, bracket structure, byes, and several opponent set scores remain unconfirmed.
notes: All records on this page are shown as wins first, losses second.
Top three from each division reach one combined six-team playoff.
The league has not published the bracket, byes, cross-division seeding, or tiebreak order.
The regular season is scheduled to end November 12, playoffs are scheduled for the week of November 16, and the championship is tentatively scheduled for Thursday, November 19 at ADP.
Explore is 6 wins and 1 loss overall and 3 wins and 1 loss in the North.
Milestones leads the North at 5 wins and 1 loss; Explore is second at 3 wins and 1 loss; Scholars and CASA are tied at 2 wins and 2 losses.
Sueño Park leads the Southwest at 3 wins and 0 losses, followed by ADP at 3 wins and 1 loss and Brighton at 3 wins and 2 losses.
Exact set and point totals from the Milestones loss and the second Scholars set were not supplied, so the page does not invent complete set or point-margin figures.
